verdict_reason: There is no source paper -- this is a BLME construction over a bundled word list -- so I checked the kernel against its own stated definition and against constructed ground truth, and it is faithful. With k_eff = max(1, min(20, m-1)) the statistic is exactly 'mean over the m category tokens of the fraction of the k_eff nearest cosine neighbours in the whole vocabulary carrying the same label', its attainable maximum is now 1.0 for every category and tokenizer, and the name '<cat>_purity' is defensible for the first time. I re-measured the artefact the fix targeted: digits maps to 10 tokens on Llama-3.2-1B / Qwen2.5-0.5B / SmolLM2-135M / gemma-3-1b, and under the old fixed k=20 all four returned EXACTLY 0.4500 = 9/20, the ceiling, i.e. a censored constant; they now return 0.9000 / 1.0000 / 1.0000 / 1.0000, which is the real geometry (each digit token's 9 nearest neighbours are the other 9 digits). The separation, hubness, relation-consistency and analogy kernels compute what their code says. The remaining code defects (global np.random.seed, 90 of 100 dead random draws, first-in-JSON-order label assignment) do not change what the purity statistic is.
comparable_reason: The adaptive k does NOT make the feature cross-model comparable; it exchanges one artefact for another, and I measured both. (1) NEW SCALE ARTEFACT, and it reverses an ordering. k_eff is set by the tokenizer, so digits is estimated at k=19 on gpt2/pythia-70m (m=20) and at k=9 on Llama/Qwen/SmolLM2/gemma (m=10). As shipped, digits_purity reads gpt2 0.5421 vs Llama-3.2-1B 0.9000 -- Llama 66% higher. At a MATCHED k=9 on the same embeddings the same two models read gpt2 0.9167 vs Llama 0.9000, i.e. gpt2 is slightly HIGHER: the shipped ordering is an artefact of the neighbourhood scale, not of the geometry. Purity is steeply k-dependent with labels and geometry held fixed -- gpt2 digits 1.0000 (k=2) / 0.9167 (k=9) / 0.5421 (k=19); gpt2 currencies 0.7308 (k=2) / 0.3205 (k=12); pythia-70m seasons 0.8889 (k=2) / 0.5294 (k=17) -- so two models measured at different k_eff are not measuring the same thing. Across 6 locally-run tokenizers k_eff for currencies is 10-20 and for digits 9-19, and on TinyLlama currencies maps to 3 tokens, giving k_eff=2 and a 7-valued statistic. (2) THE OLD ARTEFACT IS GONE but the vocabulary term is untouched, because k_eff is 20 for every large category on every tokenizer I tested: pronouns_purity vs log(vocab) over the 6 models is Pearson -0.934 (p=0.0064), colors -0.794; the label-independent expectation is algebraically (m-1)/(V-1). (3) Feature presence is still tokenizer-determined: multi_digit maps to 0 tokens on Qwen2.5-0.5B, SmolLM2-135M and gemma-3-1b (present with m=57/55 on gpt2/pythia), so the column exists as a function of whether the tokenizer splits digits.
normalized_ok_detail: Still no normalized value is emitted. The fix added two DIAGNOSTICS, _meta_{cat}_k_eff and _meta_{cat}_n_tokens, which is a real improvement in auditability -- but both carry the _meta_ prefix and are dropped from the feature matrix, so nothing downstream can tell that gpt2's digits_purity was measured at k=19 and Llama's at k=9. A genuinely comparable variant would either fix k and divide by min(k, m-1) (ceiling 1.0 at ONE scale for all models) or report a rank-based, m-free quantity such as mean same-category neighbour rank against the (m-1)/(V-1) chance baseline. cross_model_comparable=False is still emitted and, as before, read by nothing.
github_reason: No introducing paper and no released reference code exist; task_metadata.py itself grades this 'proxy-only' with an empty reference field, which is accurate. The nearest external kin (Mikolov-style analogy accuracy, lexical-clustering purity) do not use this taxonomy, this single-token tokenizer filter, this random-vocabulary separation baseline or this fixed-k purity definition, so there is nothing to fetch and cross-run.
paper_reason: No source paper, therefore no published value. Published word-analogy accuracies (Google/MSR analogy sets) are not comparable: this task scores only inflectional pairs drawn from its own asset file, restricts them to words that tokenize to a single id in the model's own tokenizer, and searches the full model vocabulary, so its denominator and candidate set differ from every published analogy benchmark.
confounds_reason: Re-measured on 6 locally-loaded embedding tables (vocab 49,152-262,144): pronouns_purity vs log(vocab) Pearson -0.934 (p=0.0064, Spearman -0.771), colors_purity -0.794 (p=0.059). Values: pronouns 0.4007 (gpt2, V=50257), 0.4754 (pythia-70m, 50304), 0.3647 (SmolLM2-135M, 49152), 0.2127 (Llama-3.2-1B, 128256), 0.1821 (Qwen2.5-0.5B, 151936), 0.1643 (gemma-3-1b, 262144) -- monotone in vocabulary. The adaptive k cannot have changed this because k_eff = 20 for pronouns on all six (m = 67-70). d_model and n_layers are not read by this task at all; it uses only the input embedding matrix. On top of the vocabulary term, k_eff itself now tracks tokenizer generation (digit-splitting tokenizers give m=10, k_eff=9 for digits), so the measurement scale is correlated with model recency and hence with capability.
defects: The adaptive k makes k_eff tokenizer-dependent and the resulting purities are estimated at different neighbourhood scales, which is enough to REVERSE a cross-model ordering: shipped digits_purity gpt2 0.5421 (k=19) < Llama-3.2-1B 0.9000 (k=9), but at matched k=9 gpt2 0.9167 > Llama 0.9000. The scale is recorded only in _meta_{cat}_k_eff, which the analysis drops.

Under label-independent geometry the expected value is still exactly (m-1)/(V-1), so the feature retains an algebraic vocabulary term: pronouns_purity vs log(vocab) Pearson -0.934 (p=0.0064) over 6 models, unchanged by the fix because k_eff=20 for every large category.

Three np.random.seed(42) calls remain (categories.py:145, 302, 386) and reset the GLOBAL legacy NumPy RNG, so any later consumer of that stream (scipy/sklearn defaults, other tasks) becomes dependent on task execution order.

7 words are still listed in two categories in assets/categories.json (your, their, this, that, these, those -> pronouns+determiners; 'in' -> prepositions+units) and are assigned first-in-JSON-order, so determiners_purity is computed on a token set stripped of 6 of its own listed words while determiner tokens sit in pronoun neighbourhoods labelled 'pronouns'.

Very small categories give a coarse, high-variance statistic: TinyLlama maps currencies to 3 tokens -> k_eff=2, so the feature takes one of 7 possible values; a 2-token category gives k_eff=1 and a 3-valued feature. There is no minimum-m guard (only len(tids) < 2 is skipped).
_compute_separation still draws 100 random comparison tokens and then uses only random_tids[:10]; 90 of the 100 draws are dead.

Structural missingness still tracks tokenizer generation: multi_digit maps to 0 tokens on Qwen2.5-0.5B, SmolLM2-135M and gemma-3-1b but 57/55 on gpt2/pythia-70m, so whether the column exists is a deterministic function of the tokenizer.

The analogy estimator still switches rule with the surviving pair count (all n(n-1) ordered pairs below 20 pairs, exactly 200 sampled pairs at or above), so its variance and selection rule flip with tokenization.
geometry_categories and geometry_unembedding still map different token sets from the same assets/categories.json.
fix: The adaptive-k change is an improvement on faithfulness and should stand, but it does not fix comparability and should not be presented as having done so. To make the column comparable, fix k at 20 for every model and report same_cat / min(k, m-1) -- ceiling 1.0 at ONE neighbourhood scale -- or, better, replace purity with an m-free rank statistic (mean reciprocal rank of same-category neighbours, or precision-at-(m-1) divided by the (m-1)/(V-1) chance rate). Promote k_eff and n_tokens out of _meta_ so the analysis can see the scale it is comparing. Drop or explicitly gate categories with structural zeros (multi_digit, digits). Deduplicate assets/categories.json and support multi-label membership. Replace the three np.random.seed(42) calls with a local np.random.default_rng(seed). Use the 100 drawn tokens in _compute_separation or draw 10. Residualise on vocab_size before any purity column enters a beyond-scale capability regression.
